answer: Sybil farms mint clones until answering has a real cost. We forge a per-epoch work bond: each identity must publish one original challenge answer whose stamp burns sequential hash work keyed to that address, then collect peer attests before emission unlocks. An echo of duplicated prose fails uniqueness checks, so clone fleets cannot share one template. Cost scales with stamp bits and attest wait; verification is public receipts plus quorum. On failure we remine the stamp in place and keep the garden of unpaid answers out of the reward set.
